security.onlineRevocationHelp.proposed: Off by default and applies to all accounts. When on, Mailven asks the certificate's issuer whether a signer's certificate was cancelled. The issuer can then see when you read or download messages. When it's off or the check fails, signed messages show a warning.
security.onlineRevocationHelp.notes: SEC-1, COPY-2. Verified: default false (settings/store.go:1167), OCSP/CRL contact (smime/revocation.go).

security.noPGPKeysHelp.proposed: You haven't added a key yet. Import a key file (.asc, .gpg, .key or .pub) to sign and encrypt messages.

security.keyServersHelp.proposed: Mailven looks for recipients' keys on these servers, in order. If you remove them all, Mailven uses its built-in list.
